Here is the most useful thing I have learned about numbers, and it has nothing to do with numbers. When something falls, most people decide in the first hour, and the first hour is the worst hour to decide anything in. You are not analysing at that point. You are reacting, and reacting feels exactly like thinking, which is the problem. So write the branch down in advance. If it drops below this level, I will do that. If it drops below the next one, I will do this instead. Write it while nothing is happening, because that is the only time your judgement is actually available. A plan with no branch in it is not a plan. It is a hope with a spreadsheet attached.

Hi, about Thursday. Two things could still go wrong and I want us to agree now what we do in each case. First, the client may call it off. He has done that twice and it is nobody's fault. If he calls it off, we send the summary anyway and we ask for fifteen minutes on Monday. Second, the second signature may not arrive in time, and if that happens nothing goes out at all, so we say so on the call rather than promising a date. One favour before Thursday. Please make sure the numbers are in the shared file, so that whatever happens, nobody is looking for a document while the client is waiting. Thanks.
